title: Hai Janaza Haider e Karrar Ka
body:
Hai Janaza Haider e Karrar Ka
Momino do mil ke kandha,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Chal basa Zainab ka baba,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Kis ne yeh mehrab mai rukn e hidayat daha diya,yeh sitam kaisa hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Noha ye jibreel ka tha,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Rok lo bhaiyya janaza mere baba jaan ka,ro ke Zainab ne kaha
Dekh loon chehra dubara,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Koi Zainab se yeh keh de ro le jee bhar ker abhi,sath hain bhai sab hee
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai salamat tera parda,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Eid hai nazdeek aur ghar mai qayamat hogayi,hai saf e matam bichi
Keh rahi hai ro ke Zehra,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Kon kufe ke yateemo ka rakhe ga ab khayal,gham se hain saare nidhal
<<DIVIDER>>
Shor hai wa gurbata ka,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Baap ke qadmon pe sar rakh ker haram ki aas ne ,yeh kaha Abbas ne
Alvida ghazu ke baba,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Teer aye ga janaze per na phathar aye ga,aur na wapis jaye ga
<<DIVIDER>>
Shan se yeh dafan hoga,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Sham ka ahwal jab beti se kehte the Ali,ghan ke maare us ghari
Zard tha Muala ka chehra,hai janaza Haider karar ka
Hai taqallum yeh qayamat roze daron ke liye,pursa daron ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Ao dein Mehdi ko pursa,hai janaza Haider karar ka
